subject: MAP timeline adjustment proposal — intervention options
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@cloudwave.io>, David Ruiz <d.ruiz@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP timeline adjustment proposal — intervention options

Hi Sophie / David,

Quick note following the weekly cadence: our latest acceptance engineering pass revealed two items (data export schema and SSO smoke tests) that will push the final acceptance milestone beyond the original close date unless we take one of the intervention options below. We want to be transparent and propose a clear, trackable path rather than a surprise delay.

Summary (short):
- Risk: Acceptance window slips by an estimated 8–12 business days if we continue on the current plan.
- Root causes: one remaining SSO test failure (intermittent) + unanticipated schema mapping work for third‑party export.
- Impact: go‑live readiness and payer integration sign‑off timelines are the main downstream drivers.

Options we recommend (pick one):
1) Fast buffer (recommended): add a 10 business‑day acceptance buffer; push target close to 2025-07-01; Redwood provides 1 week of engineering runway (no extra fees) and we prioritize the KV cache + SSO hotfix.
2) Phased acceptance: split MAP — initial feature slice on original date, full data export on later date; requires a partial MPA amendment (procurement OK).
3) Escalate for procurement acceleration: CloudWave asks procurement to expedite the export vendor SLA (we can help with a short template).

What we need from you this week:
- Confirm which option you prefer by EOD Thursday (2025-06-12).
- If you choose option 1 or 2, please confirm the new procurement acceptance window and any internal sign‑off dates.

Attachments: draft MAP update (rw_map_v3.pdf) and risk snapshot (cw_risk_log_v2.xlsx). Also linking the updated mutual action plan in Drive.

If helpful, we can run a 30‑minute triage with your SRE + our on‑call to reproduce the SSO intermittency — propose Wed 11th 11:00am PT.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0103

--
Attachment stubs: rw_map_v3.pdf (application/pdf), cw_risk_log_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@cloudwave.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Ruiz <d.ruiz@cloudwave.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline adjustment proposal — intervention options

Thanks for the quick summary, Evelyn. Sorry to hear about the SSO flakiness — we've been wrestling with that intermittency for a bit.

Initial thoughts: we prefer option 2 (phased acceptance) because the payer rollout depends on the data export but the core feature can be validated earlier. That said, I need a short matrix of what exactly is in the "initial feature slice" vs the "full data export" so our PMs and procurement can sign off.

Can you send a one‑page scope split and the proposed procurement amendment language? Also, procurement wants a clear list of tasks they must complete (vendor SLA change, PO amendment steps) and a new target sign‑off date.

Quick answers to your asks:
- We'll decide by Thu EOD (we're aligned to try).
- We can do the triage call Wed 11th at 11am PT — adding our SRE, David, to the call.

Sophie Chen
VP Product, CloudWave Health
Sophie.Chen@cloudwave.io | +1 415 777 1212

Hi Sophie / David —

Following the triage call this morning, we captured an actionable risk log and two mitigation lanes. Attaching the working risk tracker (cw_risk_log_v2.xlsx) and a proposed amendment to the mutual action plan (rw_map_v3.pdf). Key items below.

Risk snapshot (short):
- SSO intermittent: root cause traced to token refresh timing on one of CloudWave's staging certs; engineering remediation estimated 3 business days with a 2x test window.
- Export schema mismatch: there are three fields that will require downstream transforms; Redwood can backfill one transform, vendor needs to sign an addendum for the other two.

Mitigation lanes (recommended order):
A) Immediate hotfix + buffer: Redwood implements SSO hotfix and runs extended smoke tests (3 days). We propose a 10 business‑day acceptance buffer to absorb the backfill and vendor SLA amendment.
B) Phased delivery + gating: push data export to Phase 2 (new acceptance date 2025-07-08), carry forward feature QA for Phase 1 on the original close date. This requires a short MPA addendum and procurement signoff on the Phase 2 PO.
C) Vendor addendum acceleration: CloudWave procurement requests expedited addendum; if the vendor approves within 48 hours we may avoid the full buffer.

Ask from Redwood:
- If you select A or B, we'll need a signed MPA addendum. I included draft language in rw_map_v3.pdf.
- If procurement cannot commit to a rapid vendor addendum, escalate to exec sponsorship — Laura and I can prepare a short memo for your CIO to prioritize the vendor.

Attachments: cw_risk_log_v2.xlsx, rw_map_v3.pdf, procurement_timeline_snapshot.pdf (procurement steps with estimated lead times).

I'll highlight the high‑impact items in the tracker; Evelyn will follow up with a concise split scope for option 2 by EOD.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

--

Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline adjustment proposal — intervention options

Evelyn / Markus — thanks for the clear options and the fast triage. After reviewing the attached tracker and discussing with procurement + PMs, CloudWave will accept option B (phased delivery).

Decisions and next steps:
- Phase 1 (core feature validation) remains on the original target for functional acceptance; CloudWave will sign the MPA addendum for Phase 2.
- Phase 2 new acceptance target: 2025-07-08. Procurement will route the PO amendment this week with a tentative approval on 2025-06-18.
- I have routed the DocuSign link for the addendum to our legal/procurement team. Link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/CW-4983-rebaseline

Please proceed with the SSO hotfix and extended smoke window so we can keep Phase 1 stable. Evelyn — please send the Phase 1/Phase 2 scope split and a one‑page procurement checklist by EOD tomorrow so I can close the loop with our PM.

David Ruiz
Director of Engineering, CloudWave Health
David.Ruiz@cloudwave.io | +1 415 888 9900
